name: 3CX-style DLL Side-Load: Companion DLL from User-Writable Path
description: Detects a process loading d3dcompiler_47.dll or ffmpeg.dll from a user-writable directory outside Windows/Program Files — the 3CX supply-chain side-load primitive where a trusted signed app loads an untrusted companion DLL.
query: library where dll.name in~ ("d3dcompiler_47.dll", "ffmpeg.dll") and not startswith~(dll.path, "C:\\Windows\\") and not startswith~(dll.path, "C:\\Program Files\\") and not startswith~(dll.path, "C:\\Program Files (x86)\\") and (dll.path : "*\\Users\\*" or dll.path : "*\\AppData\\*" or dll.path : "*\\ProgramData\\*" or dll.path : "*\\Temp\\*")
false_positives: Portable applications that bundle runtime DLLs in a user directory

name: Browser Credential Store Collection by Non-Browser Process
description: Detects a non-browser process reading browser credential/history stores (Login Data, key4.db, logins.json, Cookies) across Chrome/Edge/Brave/Firefox — the ICONIC infostealer collection pattern observed in the 3CX intrusion.
query: file where event.action in ("open", "read", "access") and (file.name in~ ("Login Data", "Web Data", "Cookies", "logins.json", "key4.db") or file.path : ("*\\Google\\Chrome\\User Data*", "*\\Microsoft\\Edge\\User Data*", "*\\BraveSoftware\\Brave-Browser\\User Data*", "*\\Mozilla\\Firefox\\Profiles*")) and not process.name in~ ("chrome.exe", "msedge.exe", "firefox.exe", "brave.exe")
false_positives: Backup/sync agents that legitimately read browser profiles

name: ICO Retrieval from GitHub CDN by Non-Browser Process
description: Detects a non-browser process fetching a .ico resource from raw.githubusercontent.com — the 3CX second-stage steganographic C2 config retrieval (icons with appended AES config in the IconStorages repository).
query: network where event.action == "connection_attempted" and (url.full : "*raw.githubusercontent.com*" or dns.question.name == "raw.githubusercontent.com") and not process.name in~ ("chrome.exe", "msedge.exe", "firefox.exe", "brave.exe", "git.exe", "code.exe")
false_positives: Developer tooling fetching icons or assets from GitHub

name: Hypervisor Artifact Fingerprinting by Non-System Process
description: Detects a non-system process reading multiple hypervisor/sandbox artifact registry keys (BIOS strings, virtual-disk enum, guest-additions services) — the pre-beacon sandbox-evasion fingerprint before the 3CX dormancy period.
query: registry where event.action in ("query", "open") and registry.path : ("*HARDWARE\\DESCRIPTION\\System\\BIOS*", "*CurrentControlSet\\Services\\Disk\\Enum*", "*CurrentControlSet\\Services\\VBoxGuest*", "*CurrentControlSet\\Services\\vmtools*", "*CurrentControlSet\\Services\\vmci*") and not startswith~(process.executable, "C:\\Windows\\")

name: Signed Binary Loads Non-Microsoft DLL from Its Own Writable Directory
description: Generic 3CX-class side-load hunt: a signed executable running from a user-writable directory loads a DLL from that same directory. Catches the trusted-signed-binary-behaves-anomalously pattern beyond the specific companion DLL names.
query: library where dll.name : "*.dll" and process.code_signature.exists == true and (process.executable : ("*\\Users\\*", "*\\AppData\\*", "*\\ProgramData\\*", "*\\Public\\*")) and not startswith~(dll.path, "C:\\Windows\\") and not startswith~(dll.path, "C:\\Program Files")
false_positives: Legitimate portable/signed applications running from user directories with bundled DLLs
